load_hg_model_simple: load a HuggingFace model into fairseq2 with minimal configuration using a model name and optional device
load_hg_tokenizer_simple: load a HuggingFace tokenizer with custom special tokens like pad, eos, and bos tokens
load_causal_lm: load a causal language model like GPT-2 or LLaMA for text generation tasks
load_seq2seq_lm: load a sequence-to-sequence model like T5 for translation or summarization tasks
load_multimodal_model: load a multimodal model with an AutoProcessor for vision-language tasks
